findings.message: Not a sense error, outside T4.2: words.w1.components[0] is marked gender 'masculine', but its sense.gloss 'a living supernatural being, spiritual apparition' comes from MW's neuter entry yakṣa n. (mw-yaksha.md, p. 838,2). The masculine entry is 'N. of a class of semi-divine beings (attendants of Kubera...)'. The neuter sense is the better fit for Śiva and for the Kena-style reading noted in text-report.md, so the sense choice itself passes. The gender label and the dictionary entry should still match.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the neuter-entry sense and set the component's gender to 'neuter', or note that inside the compound the member stem's gender is not decided.
